title: Getting Around Chennai: The Main Public Transport Options

content: Chennai residents and visitors can combine several public transport options. City buses run by the Metropolitan Transport Corporation cover a large network of routes across the city.
The Chennai Metro Rail serves several corridors, and the suburban railway network connects the city centre with outlying areas. Auto-rickshaws and app-based cabs fill the gaps for shorter trips.
Routes, timings and fares change, so always check the operator's official website or app before travelling.
